question.en: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
question.zh: 吉尔伯特先生为什么给米灵顿医生打电话？

sentences.en: Why did Mr. Gilbert telephone Dr. Millington?
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特先生为什么给米灵顿医生打电话？

sentences.en: While John Gilbert was in hospital,
sentences.zh: 约翰·吉尔伯特住院期间，

sentences.en: he asked his doctor to tell him whether his operation had been successful,
sentences.zh: 他要求医生告诉他手术是否成功，

chunks.x: whether his operation had been successful

sentences.en: but the doctor refused to do so.
The following day, the patient asked for a bedside telephone.
sentences.zh: 第二天，这位病人要了一部床头电话。

sentences.en: When he was alone, he telephoned the hospital exchange and asked for Doctor Millington.
sentences.zh: 当病房里没人的时候，他给医院的总机打电话，要米灵顿医生接电话。

sentences.en: When the doctor answered the phone,
Mr. Gilbert said he was inquiring about a certain patient,
sentences.zh: 吉尔伯特先生说他想打听一个病人的情况，

chunks.x: he was inquiring about a certain patient

sentences.zh: 一位叫约翰·吉尔伯特的先生。
sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: He asked if Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful
sentences.zh: 他问吉尔伯特先生的手术是否成功，

chunks.x: if Mr. Gilbert 's operation had been successful

sentences.en: and the doctor told him that it had been.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉他手术很成功。

sentences.en: He then asked when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home
sentences.zh: 接着他又问吉尔伯特先生什么时候可以回家，

chunks.x: when Mr. Gilbert would be allowed to go home

sentences.en: and the doctor told him that he would have to stay in hosptial for another two weeks.
sentences.zh: 医生说他还得再住两个星期。

sentences.en: Then Dr. Millington asked the caller if he was a relative of the patient.
sentences.zh: 后来米灵顿医生问打电话的人是不是病人的亲属。
